host.description: Host name for the application, like 'forgejo.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

admin_username.title: Admin username
admin_username.description: Initial administrator account username. Defaults to 'forgejo-admin' if left empty. Note: 'admin' is a reserved name in Forgejo and cannot be used.

admin_email.title: Admin email
admin_email.description: Initial administrator account email. Defaults to admin@<host> if left empty.

allow_registration.title: Allow user registration
allow_registration.description: Allow anyone to sign up for a new account. Disabled by default: only the admin can create new accounts.
